title: Tips for Pet Groomers to Boost Sales - EnvisionNow

facts.fact: Accenture statistics cited by EnvisionNow state that 91% of consumers prefer brands that provide personalized offers and recommendations.
facts.quote: Statistics show that 91% of consumers prefer brands that provide personalized offers and recommendations (Accenture).

facts.fact: CXL Institute research cited by EnvisionNow says it takes just 50 milliseconds for a potential client to form an impression about a pet grooming studio.
facts.quote: Research reveals that it takes just 50 milliseconds for a potential client to form an impression about your pet grooming studio (CXL Institute).

facts.fact: Marketing Metrics data cited by EnvisionNow gives a 60-70% probability of selling to an existing client versus 5-20% for a new client.
facts.quote: Data indicates that the probability of selling to an existing client is 60-70%, while the probability of selling to a new client is only 5-20% (Marketing Metrics).

facts.fact: A quote attributed to Daniel Kahneman on the page states that loss aversion is twice as powerful as gains.
facts.quote: Loss aversion is twice as powerful as gains.

facts.fact: A quote attributed to Lee Resources International on the page states that it costs five times as much to attract a new client than to keep an existing one.
facts.quote: It costs five times as much to attract a new client than to keep an existing one.

facts.fact: According to BrightLocal, as cited on the page, 88% of consumers trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations.
facts.quote: Consumers rely heavily on social proof, with 88% trusting online reviews as much as personal recommendations (BrightLocal).

facts.fact: According to Harvard Business Review, as cited on the page, loyal clients spend 67% more on average than new ones.
facts.quote: loyal clients spend 67% more on average than new ones (Harvard Business Review)
